618-6495-6966.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of All-Fates Stalker.
When the All-Fates Stalker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the All-Fates Stalker token.
When the All-Fates Stalker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
618-6495-6966.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

240-4927-5470-8095.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat from step 2.

4365-4772-6753-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3446-4067-5078-7914.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Iron Lad.
Activate Iron Lad by tapping it, revealing Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library and then drawing it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Herald of Kozilek.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the other Angel on the battlefield

3259-6965-7917--185.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6965-7917--185.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Seluma, triggering both Breath of Fury and Seluma.
Resolve the Seluma trigger, returning an Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Angel returned in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-6965-7917--185.notes: One of the two additional Angels must be on the battlefield with the other in your graveyard. If both chosen Angels have haste, then Frostcliff Siege can be omitted.

1558-2557-2638-3257-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2557-2638-3257-4231.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Parallel Lives.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

57-2751-4846-7175.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-2751-4846-7175.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

30-147-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
30-147-5686.description:
Cast Storm of Souls by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Storm of Souls.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Storm of Souls
Resolve the Storm of Souls copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
30-147-5686.notes: You can return any amount of creature cards with Storm of Souls as desired.

3652-5220-5256-6900.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

203-5195-6259.description:
Cast Anoint with buyback by paying {W}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Anoint.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

222-527-1251-2034.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2103-2493-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Capture of Jingzhou and Archaeomancer each turn.
2103-2493-6122.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Archaeomancer by paying its mana cost.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Archaeomancer from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1809-2061-3617.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Walk each turn.
1809-2061-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Returned Pastcaller.
When the Returned Pastcaller token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of the creature with persist.

2511-3388--5.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Moritte of the Frost.
When Moritte of the Frost dies, it triggers its persist ability, returning itself to the battlefield as a copy of the creature with persist with two +1/+1 counters and one -1/-1 counter on it.
Remove one +1/+1 counter and one -1/-1 counter from Moritte of the Frost as a state-based action.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoissuer.
Repeat.

1912-4131-4324.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
1912-4131-4324.description:
At the beginning of combat, Workshop Elders triggers, making Basalt Monolith a 0/0 artifact creature until end of turn and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1558-2499-2963-4231-4979.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Gilded Goose.
When Gilded Goose enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two Food, two Clue and two Treasure artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

1232-1563-4231-4321.description:
Activate Nemata by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token as well as a Food, a Clue and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Food, Clue and Treasure by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

3043-4896.notablePrerequisites:
Axebane Guardian does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five creatures with defender.
3043-4896.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least {3}{W}{U}.
Activate High Alert by paying {2}{W}{U}, untapping Axebane Guardian.
Repeat.
